ckd.aciklama: Prediction of chronic kidney disease (CKD) from clinical values. At least 6 fields and at least one of Creatinine / Urea / Urine sp. gravity / Albumin / Hemoglobin are required; the remaining fields can be left empty (they are filled in automatically — the more values, the more accurate). The finding buttons alone are not enough.
ckd.nokta1: The result is based on the 24 clinical values entered; empty fields are estimated (imputed).
ckd.nokta2: This is a screening prediction, not a definitive diagnosis.
ckd.onKontrol: Fill in at least {{minAlan}} fields (currently {{dolu}}) and enter at least one value related to kidney function: {{eksik}}. The finding buttons alone are not enough.

sonuc.ckdMetin: According to the entered clinical values, the model indicates chronic kidney disease (CKD) with {{pct}}% probability. Early diagnosis is very important in CKD; confirm this result with blood / urine tests and a veterinarian's evaluation.
sonuc.dusukMetin: According to the entered values, the probability of CKD is low ({{pct}}%). Even so, periodic checks and a veterinarian's evaluation are recommended if there is any suspicion.

ckd.tamamlanamadi: The kidney analysis could not be completed. Check the values and try again.

ct.aciklama: Detection of stones, cysts and kidney tissue in a kidney CT image (YOLOv8s).
ct.bulguDegerlendirilemedi: No kidney tissue was found, so stones and cysts could not be assessed — check that the image is a kidney CT slice.
ct.guvenNotu: “Confidence” is the probability that the model recognizes that region correctly. The confidence of the two kidney tissues may differ (e.g. 89% and 87%) — these are not two measurements of the same kidney but two separate kidney regions in the image.
ct.ipucuNet: • Choose / photograph a sharp, single-slice kidney CT image
ct.ipucuRenk: • Red = stone, green = kidney, orange = cyst
ct.isiHaritasiNot: The red regions are the areas the model relied on most when deciding on the detections in the boxes (not diagnostic evidence; read it together with the boxes).
ct.isiHaritasiUret: 🔍 Generate heat map (detection-targeted HiRes-CAM — the regions that led the model to the detections)
ct.ozetYok: No kidney structure could be detected in the image.

fantom.aciklama: Detects blue tumor foci in a synthetic kidney phantom; produces a 3D position + PEMF coil / E-field estimate.
fantom.hesaplandi: An electric field (E) falling on cancerous and healthy tissue was calculated for each tumor; the duty settings (D1–D7) of the 7 PEMF coils were produced accordingly.
fantom.ipucuBoy: • The phantom length (cm) is used only if the ring or the cabin marker is not visible
fantom.ipucuHalka: • <kalin>Most of the green coil ring</kalin> should be in the frame — the scale comes from it
fantom.ipucuMavi: • Blue tumor dots should be clearly visible; the phantom should be at least ~300 px in the frame
fantom.ipucuUst: • Photograph the phantom <kalin>straight from above</kalin>, sharp and well lit
fantom.nokta1: A higher E_cancer means the field is more focused on that region.
fantom.nokta2: The D1–D7 bars show each coil's drive ratio (duty %).
fantom.nokta3: 3D coordinate: the position of the tumor center within the scale / cabin frame.

fgs.bantNotu: The band is the p5–p95 range of the healthy calibration population; a value outside the band is not a diagnosis on its own.

hafif.metin: There may be a mild discomfort or tension. Keep observing; if you wish, you can ease it with PEMF.
hafif.nokta1: Ear / eye / nose / whisker / head position scores are below.
hafif.nokta2: FGS = Feline Grimace Scale (facial pain scale).

kalibrasyon.aciklama: Calibrate once while the camera is fixed to the top lid: place the 24-well plate with filled wells on one side of the cabin (e.g. left ring), take a frame and measure at least two of the numbered corners with a ruler; then place the plate on the other side (right ring) and repeat.

devam.aciklama: Only if the "The camera may have moved" warning appeared: calibrate again, or if the shift is small (up to ~2 cm) continue without calibrating — positions may be off by ~1–2 cm.
devam.tamam: Scene renewed (shift {{px}} px) — the calibration is marked as "outdated".

kalibrasyon.dogrulaAciklama: Place the plate somewhere else and enter the numbered corners you measured. The calibration is verified if the difference at the plate center is below 2 cm.
kalibrasyon.dogrulamaGecti: Verification PASSED — difference at the plate center {{merkez}} cm (limit {{esik}} cm); corners: {{farklar}} cm.
kalibrasyon.dogrulamaKaldi: Verification FAILED — difference at the plate center {{merkez}} cm (limit {{esik}} cm); corners: {{farklar}} cm. Check the measurements or calibrate again.
kalibrasyon.durumVar: Calibration: {{tarih}} · {{n}} positions · reprojection {{px}} px · lens difference {{cm}} cm
kalibrasyon.durumYok: No calibration — Well Plate / phantom AI Pro coil driving does not start without a calibration.
kalibrasyon.eski: OUTDATED calibration ({{tarih}}): work continued without calibrating after the camera moved — positions may be off by ~1–2 cm; calibrate again when you can.

fantom.aciklama: The phantom stands on the floor; the tumors are seen on its top surface. Measure and enter the thickness (floor to top surface) and the tumor depth (from the top surface); length / width are optional (for the empty-cabin check).

kalibrasyon.gorusAlani: On the floor the camera does not see the first ~{{on}} cm from the front glass (blind zone) — place the sample inside the rings.
kalibrasyon.hata: The calibration request failed — try again.

kalibrasyon.kareEtiketi: Calibration frame — plate outline and numbered corners

kalibrasyon.kilitli: The calibration cannot be changed while AI Pro preparation / a session is running.

konum.ipucu: The first position must be on one side of the cabin and the second on the other side (at least 20 cm between centers) — two positions on the same side cannot measure the opposite side.

kalibrasyon.lensBaslik: Lens position and height (measured, cm) — checks the calibration; the base height setting uses it too
kalibrasyon.olcuAciklama: Enter the distance to the left glass and to the front glass in cm for at least two of the numbered corners in the image (preferably diagonal: 1 and 3 or 2 and 4).
kalibrasyon.sahneYok: The fixed scene in the calibration frame is weak — camera movement is checked only by the well spacing and the phantom cannot be driven. Stick a patterned tape on the cabin floor and calibrate again.

organ.bulunamadiMetin: The cat / organs could not be clearly made out in this image. Make sure the whole cat is in the frame, the light is good and the image is sharp; try a closer side / top frame.

patoloji.aciklama: Grade classification on a kidney tissue (biopsy) image: Grade 0–4 (V22-KMC-ClassicTrio).
patoloji.guvenNotu: “Confidence” is the probability that the model assigns the image to that grade. Grade 0 is the mildest and Grade 4 the most advanced histopathological grade; neighboring grades (e.g. 2↔3) may look similar.
patoloji.ipucuDerece: • Grade 0 = mildest, Grade 4 = most advanced histopathological grade
patoloji.ipucuNet: • Choose a sharp, single-slice histopathology (microscope) image
patoloji.isiHaritasiUret: 🔍 Generate heat map (3-model consensus + uncertainty — may take minutes on CPU)
patoloji.kararsizlikNot: In the bright regions the three models DISAGREE — the grade is less reliable there.
patoloji.konsensusNot: The tissue regions that all three models rely on.

petri.a1Notu: The A1 corner is not read from the image (laboratory item): automatic = top-left for a horizontal plate, top-right for a vertical one. If the plate was rotated 180°, choose the opposite corner.
petri.aciklama: Detects wells in a well plate photo; produces a cancer classification for each well + a PEMF coil / E-field estimate.
petri.advNotPlaka: In plate mode the plate geometry determines where the wells are; detection confidence and the "not a petri dish" thresholds do not change the result in this mode (they are shown only in single-dish mode). A field you leave empty stays at its default.
petri.advNotTekil: If wells cannot be found, the first two levers to try: lowering detection confidence and turning on downscaling. A field you leave empty stays at its default.
petri.advNotYalnizPlaka: The plate geometry determines where the wells are. A field you leave empty stays at its default.

kuyuSkorEsigi.ipucu: If a grid cell's score (the number on the "02 – YOLO Well Detection" panel: the share of the cell covered by medium or dye) is below this value, the cell is not counted as a well. 0 = off. Raising it drops cells that fall off the plate or are empty; raising it too far also drops real, partly filled wells.

plausAreaFrac.ipucu: If a single detection covers more than this fraction of the frame, the image is not considered a petri dish (VETO vote).

plausCircularity.ipucu: The circularity vote of the "not a petri dish" check.

plausConf.ipucu: The confidence vote of the check. Most of the measured rejection cases fell short on this vote (0.44–0.80).

resizeMax.ipucu: The model input is FIXED at 640 px; wells vanish in a very large photo. 0 = off. The scale is not affected (mm/px comes from the well diameter or the cabin marker).

yoloConf.ipucu: Lowering it finds more wells (measured: 0.25 → 0.05 ⇒ 3 wells instead of 1); the risk of false detections increases.

yoloIou.ipucu: Raise it if adjacent wells merge into a single detection.

petri.ayarNotu: From the advanced (research) settings, lower the detection confidence (0.25 → 0.05 ⇒ 3 wells instead of 1) or turn on downscaling (e.g. 960).
petri.denetimAcik: “Not a petri dish” check is on
petri.denetimKapaliUyari: ⚠️ The check is off: a photo uploaded to the wrong module also produces a result, and that result will be misleading.
petri.elenenKuyular: {{n}} grid cells were not counted as wells (score below {{esik}}): {{kuyular}}

etkin.baslik: ⚙️ This result was produced with changed settings: {{ayarlar}}

petri.gelismisAc: Opens the detection and verification thresholds
petri.ipucuKenar: • Keep the plate edges in the frame; make sure light reflections do not fall in the middle of a well
petri.ipucuKontrol: • In every experiment, photograph one known stained and one healthy <kalin>control well</kalin> (Advanced settings)
petri.ipucuUst: • Photograph the plate <kalin>from directly above, upright and close</kalin> — the plate should fill at least half of the frame
petri.kadrajNotu: Framing test measured: moving closer to the plate raised the count from 1 well to 5 wells.
petri.kontrolNotu: Cancer thresholds were validated only with artificial dye (laboratory item): the control wells adjust the thresholds to this plate; if a control is misclassified, the result is not used.
petri.plakaKipiNotu: Plate mode looks for the plate from the pink medium / stained wells; keep the plate edges in the frame.
petri.plakaNotu: The scale comes from the well spacing of the plate (19.3 mm). If the cabin marker (ArUco) is not in the frame, well positions are in the PLATE frame and the PEMF values are considered invalid.
petri.qrNotu: If a QR marker is in the photo, the position is extracted automatically (QR); otherwise it is scaled with the petri diameter.

retikulosit.dusuk: The reticulocyte ratio appears to be in the low-to-normal range. If anemia is present it may be non-regenerative; a definitive interpretation requires clinical context.
retikulosit.nokta: The numbers belong to a single microscope field and are not a diagnostic reference range.
retikulosit.yuksek: A relatively high reticulocyte ratio may suggest that the bone marrow is producing new red blood cells (regenerative response — e.g. a reaction to bleeding / anemia). Evaluate it together with the clinical context.

rna.aciklama: Classification of kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC) from an RNA-seq gene-expression CSV.
rna.basarisiz: Analysis failed. Check the file and the connection, then try again.

rna.csvSatir: • Row = patient, column = <kalin>20531 genes</kalin> (as in training / TCGA)

rna.nokta1: Confidence = the probability the model assigns to that class.
rna.nokta2: The result is based on the gene-expression profile; it is not diagnostic on its own.

sonuc.kircVarMetin: KIRC (kidney clear cell carcinoma) is the most common type of kidney cancer. The model classified by the gene-expression (RNA-seq) pattern — even a high confidence is NOT a definitive diagnosis; clinical and pathological confirmation is required.
sonuc.kircYokMetin: The samples were classified as 'other' (not KIRC). This is a screening result and does not replace a definitive diagnosis.

agri.baslik: May Be a Sign of Pain
agri.metin: This sound may be a sign of pain or discomfort. Observe your furry friend closely; if the signs continue, consult your veterinarian.

anneCagrisi.metin: Calling for their kittens or calling out with a mothering instinct — natural behavior.

avOyun.metin: Curious and lively, with an active hunting instinct. Help them burn off energy with play.

ciftlesme.metin: A sound from the mating season. It is natural; if they seem restless, provide a calm environment.

kavga.metin: The sound of a conflict. Move them away from other animals to a safe place.

kizgin.metin: Tense right now. Give them space and don't force them; they may calm down shortly.

mutlu.metin: Your furry friend feels good and happy. Everything looks fine!

savunma.metin: They may feel threatened. Give them a safe space without forcing anything.

uyari.metin: They may be bothered or uneasy about something. Check the surroundings and calm them down.
